# PluginMetadata.PluginSettingsDirectoryPath property

The path to the plugin settings directory which is not validated. It is used to store plugin settings files and data files. When plugin is deleted, FL will ask users whether to keep its settings. If users do not want to keep, this directory will be deleted.

public string PluginSettingsDirectoryPath { get; }
